contest_rules_considered.scope: Project requirements, original-work and sole-ownership terms, compliant open-source and third-party SDK/API/data use, submission materials, language, publicity, and the 2026 submission period.

contest_rules_findings.project_requirement: A submission must be an Atlassian Forge app integrated with at least one Atlassian product or platform capability.
contest_rules_findings.ownership_and_code: The submission must be original work and solely owned by the entrant; compliant open-source software is allowed when the entrant builds on it and follows its license.
contest_rules_findings.third_party_material: Entrants must be authorized to use third-party SDKs, APIs, and data under their applicable terms.
contest_rules_findings.submitted_materials: The rules require judge access and instructions, an English description, and a public demo video under five minutes; some materials may be publicly displayed and the sponsor receives promotional rights described by the rules.
contest_rules_findings.anonymity_or_embargo: No anonymous-review or embargo requirement was found in the official rules as consulted; this does not address separate event communications.
contest_rules_findings.repository_alignment: README states this release has no Forge integration and is not a hackathon submission. No eligibility or entry is claimed.
contest_rules_findings.models: No model asset was identified; README describes a deterministic core with no model or network service.

contest_status: No Codegeist submission is claimed. The README states that Forge integration and submission are outside this research-core release; eligibility of a future submission is not established by this repository record.
